items.text: Round-1 answered decisions are fully incorporated into plan.md: d1 (hardcoded struct-literal metadata in standards.go), d2 (?rule= query param on the existing audit endpoint, backward-compatible), d3 (port prompt-manager's react-markdown + remark-gfm + marked + shiki + @tailwindcss/typography stack — MarkdownRenderer.tsx and CodeBlock.tsx — matching the existing approach used by sibling scenarios like git-control-tower / prompt-manager per the user's freeform answer), d4 (single shared scenario input at page top reused for both per-rule and batch evaluation).

Round-2 decisions d5, d6, d7 were generated but not answered. To finalize the plan, the recommended option was adopted as the default for each: d5=A (install @tailwindcss/typography and scope `prose` to the markdown wrapper), d6=A (multiple cards may be expanded simultaneously via Record<ruleId, boolean> state), d7=A (fraction summary `X/N rules passing` colored green/amber/red based on severity of any failure). If you prefer a different option for any of these, run another workshop round and the plan will be updated accordingly.

Validation-report gaps from round-1 are now resolved in plan.md: §0 contains an explicit Greenfield Declaration (with the single ScannerPage compatibility constraint called out), and §12 Rollout/Validation Checklist now includes a `vrooli scenario restart brand-manager` step framed as an operator action, not an agent action.

Initiative context (brand-manager-readiness) — sibling backlog items `execute/brand-manager-scenario-picker` and `execute/brand-manager-discovery-import-ui` are also queued, both potentially touching `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/lib/api.ts` and possibly the StandardsPage shell. The plan flags this in §9 (Risks) and §12 step 5: orchestrator should coordinate merge order across the three siblings to avoid rebase conflicts. No upstream/downstream initiatives exist, so no cross-initiative sequencing implications beyond the brand-manager-readiness members.

All 5 readiness dimensions scored 3/3. Plan covers a clearly bounded greenfield enhancement with an explicit problem statement, scoped in/out lists, named test cases on both sides, a 7-row severity-aware risk matrix, contract-level API decisions, and an operator-driven rollout checklist. Ready for the orchestrator to mark status=ready and queue for execution.

plan_updates: Rewrote plan.md as the final synthesized version: kept the round-1 structure and added (1) §0 explicit Greenfield Declaration with the single ScannerPage backward-compat constraint, (2) expanded §3 Scope to call out the markdown-stack port and explicitly exclude MarkedParser.ts, (3) refreshed §4 to enumerate the prompt-manager files and dep versions to port, (4) reorganized §6 into 5 phases including a dedicated Markdown Stack phase, (5) deepened §8 with named backend test functions and the ScannerPage regression guard, (6) expanded §9 risk matrix to 7 rows with likelihood/impact columns covering shiki bundle size, dep-add policy, ScannerPage regression, raw-HTML XSS, prose-class bleed, content drift, and sibling-item file overlap, (7) tightened §11 Definition of Done to a checkable list, (8) added §12 Rollout/Validation Checklist with the operator-driven scenario restart and a sibling-item coordination check. Adopted recommended defaults for unanswered decisions d5/d6/d7 and noted this in info items.
